resources.string: Identify the Bluetooth apps and services exposed by your Linkswell.
This build collects a report. It does not connect CarPlay yet. Your wired app stays separate.
Share this report so we can choose the next connection test.

Not tested: Bluetooth socket connections, hotspot creation, iPhone pairing, authentication or a CarPlay session. Firmware feature flags and adapter presence do not prove wireless CarPlay works. A zero paired-device count does not prove Linkswell has a separate radio. Wi-Fi 5 GHz support does not prove a 5 GHz hotspot is available. Settings handlers may redirect internally; a settings component does not prove a working Bluetooth stack. An unreported handler may still accept the shortcut.

Report includes device/build details, capability results, relevant app versions and declared service names. Only ZLink’s channel metadata is included; private app data and other metadata are not read. Phone names, Bluetooth addresses, Wi-Fi names, pairing keys, IMEI and serial numbers are not collected.
Passive Android checks only; radios and pairings are not changed.
